purpose: Pinned execution reference for the SynthRAN rework. This is separate from historical derivation provenance in SOURCE.json.

mapping.status: direct for r2lab; rfsim is reference-derived

mapping.rule: physical inventory selection and subscriber selection are distinct; attachment remains outside reference up
named reference profile only; effective/custom profile parity must be proven before migration
pass only variables already owned by the pinned reference and validated by the dependent issue

external_resource_authority.reason: Issue #52 establishes SynthRAN as the sole SLICES/POS/R2Lab acquisition and POS-preparation authority. The pinned reference may provision downstream but must not mutate resource ownership or boot state again.

reference_candidate: supported host/Kubernetes/network/core/RAN lifecycle after SynthRAN resource preparation
selected-resource teardown where later issues prove the boundary
synthran: translation and fail-closed validation before delegation
POS allocation, image, boot-parameter, reset and post-reset readiness
R2Lab lease acquisition/extension/require-existing verification and evidence
physical UE acceptance beyond reference ready

resolved_decisions.decision: SynthRAN is the sole resource-acquisition and POS-preparation authority; downstream reference resource mutation is disabled by the external_resource_authority overlay.

known_gaps.detail: Machine normalize accepts only repository-named profiles; effective SynthRAN profile injection/render parity is not yet proven.
Machine inventory derives IP/storage/NIC from fixed NODE_FACTS; SynthRAN host_vars is not mapped.
Machine SSH contract has username/known_hosts/strict policy but no explicit identity_file surface.
Pinned machine QHATS omits qhat23 although the reference default profile and SynthRAN catalog contain qhat23.
fiveg up does not invoke test-ue-connect.yml; reference ready is provisioning completion only.
SynthRAN N320-specific OAI changes are not represented by the generic machine contract.
SynthRAN chart/profile/log adaptations require rendered parity review before delegation.
Reference ready cannot publish SynthRAN active state without SynthRAN acceptance evidence.
Pinned up --resume does not reject normalized spec drift before rewriting runtime files; caller must fail closed.
